record.text: Come ask Amy anything about her coverage of Kristan Hawkins and the anti-abortion movement!

external.title: From the IAmA community on Reddit
external.description: Explore this post and more from the IAmA community

value.text:
I spent months following Kristan Hawkins, president of Students for Life and one of the country’s most influential anti-abortion leaders, for a profile and doc for @motherjones.com and @revealnews.org 

Lots of fascinating details didn’t make it into the piece. 

Head to Reddit to ask me anything!
